_doc: Reviewed exceptions for the A1 guard pack. Every entry SHOULD carry a reason. Prefer fixing over allowlisting.

serviceRoleGate._doc: Edge functions that use service-role + a request id but are trusted internal/cron callers with no user entry path.

rpcPurity._doc: SECURITY DEFINER / match_* RPCs that are intentionally cross-tenant (global, content-anonymized). Justify each.

nullTenant._doc: Tables temporarily permitted to hold client-owned rows with NULL tenant_id (e.g., active backfill). Remove ASAP.
